incidents.title: Incident Register
incidents.description: Security incident log with severity classification and timeline tracking. Required by NIS2 Art. 23.
incidents.helpText: Log every security incident when it occurs. NIS2 requires early warning to BSI within 24 hours and full notification within 72 hours for significant incidents. Record severity, affected systems, timeline, and resolution steps.
incidents.empty: No incidents recorded. Report an incident when one occurs.
incidents.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this incident?

fieldDescriptions.title: Short descriptive name for this incident (e.g., 'Phishing attack on finance department').
fieldDescriptions.description: Detailed description of what happened, which systems and data were affected, and the scope of impact.
fieldDescriptions.severity: Select the severity level. 'Significant' incidents require BSI notification within 24h (early warning) and 72h (full report) under NIS2 Art. 23.
fieldDescriptions.situationColor: Traffic-light indicator of current incident status: green (contained), amber (ongoing), red (critical).
fieldDescriptions.discoveredAt: Date and time when this incident was first detected or reported.
fieldDescriptions.occurredAt: Date and time when this incident actually began (may differ from discovery).
fieldDescriptions.resolvedAt: Date and time when this incident was fully resolved and normal operations resumed.
fieldDescriptions.confidentialityImpacted: Enable if unauthorized disclosure of information occurred or is suspected.
fieldDescriptions.integrityImpacted: Enable if unauthorized modification or corruption of data occurred or is suspected.
fieldDescriptions.availabilityImpacted: Enable if services or systems were disrupted or rendered unavailable.
fieldDescriptions.threatType: Select the type of threat (e.g., malware, DDoS, insider, phishing, vulnerability exploitation).
fieldDescriptions.rootCause: Describe the underlying cause of the incident after investigation is complete.
fieldDescriptions.countermeasures: Describe the immediate actions taken to contain and remediate the incident.
fieldDescriptions.preventiveMeasures: Describe the long-term measures implemented to prevent recurrence of this type of incident.
fieldDescriptions.requiresGdprNotification: Enable if this incident involved a personal data breach requiring notification to the supervisory authority under GDPR Art. 33 (within 72 hours of awareness).
fieldDescriptions.dataSubjectsAffected: Approximate number of data subjects whose personal data was compromised (Art. 33(3)(a): required content of notification).
fieldDescriptions.gdprNotifiedAt: Date and time the supervisory authority was notified of the breach.
fieldDescriptions.notifiedDataSubjectsAt: Date and time affected data subjects were informed (Art. 34: required when breach poses high risk).
